policy.warning: A cover rate or Under rate inside its confidence interval is not evidence of a durable edge; these studies measure the snapshot, they do not forecast it.

studies.title: Recorded wind speed against closing totals, outdoor games
studies.hypothesis: Outdoor totals fall as recorded wind rises, so Under tickets win more often above ~15 mph.
studies.method: Bucket regular-season outdoor games by the snapshot's game-time wind column; compare the final combined score against the closing total_line; flat $100 Under at the recorded under price (conventional -110 when the snapshot records no price).
studies.limitations: The wind column is a single game-time observation, not a stadium sensor series; the price column is missing for most seasons before 2020, so the flat-stake figure is only partly observed and the under rate is the primary measurement.
studies.headline: 56.34% Under rate (95% CI 51.8-60.78%) on 470 outdoor games at 15-19 mph, mean total 40.64

studies.title: Thursday games: home cover rate by travelling team rest
studies.hypothesis: A Thursday home team beats the spread more often when the visitor had four days or fewer.
studies.method: Regular-season Thursday games; settle the home side against the closing spread_line; compare visitors on <=4 days rest with the rest of the Thursday sample.
studies.limitations: Travel distance is not in the snapshot, so the cross-country split the research dossier claims cannot be re-derived here; the reported split is rest only.
studies.headline: 51.24% home cover rate on 290 Thursday games with a visitor on four days or fewer

studies.title: Divisional games with a total of 47 or higher, Under rate
studies.hypothesis: The strategy lab's declared rule - divisional games priced at 47.0 or above go Under more often than the price implies.
studies.method: Compare the final combined score with the closing total_line across all regular-season divisional games at 47.0 or above, using the whole snapshot rather than only the lab windows.
studies.limitations: This is the full-history rate, not the strategy lab's walk-forward holdout; a rate inside the confidence interval is not a claim of profitability.
studies.headline: 53.69% Under rate across 632 divisional games at 47.0 or above, flat-stake +2,774.04 USD

studies.title: Home underdogs covering the closing spread
studies.hypothesis: Home underdogs cover the spread at a rate above the price implied by the market.
studies.method: Home spread conventions in the snapshot are home handicaps, so a positive spread_line is a home underdog; settle home_team - away_team + spread_line and report cover rates for the published 2002-2011 window and for the whole snapshot.
studies.limitations: Cover rate alone is not a tradable edge: the price paid for the spread is not part of the claim, and flat-stake PnL here assumes a conventional -110 where the snapshot has no price.
studies.headline: 49.14% cover rate in 2002-2011 (840 games) and 50.06% across the whole snapshot (2464 games)

studies.title: Closing totals in climate-controlled venues against outdoor venues
studies.hypothesis: Climate-controlled venues score closer to the closing total than outdoor venues.
studies.method: Group regular-season games by the snapshot's roof column and compare realised combined points with the closing total_line.
studies.limitations: Roof values are recorded as dome/closed/open/outdoors by the provider; a retractable roof left open is not distinguishable from one closed at kickoff beyond this column.
studies.headline: mean total 46.78 indoors against 43.21 outdoors; Under rate 48.9% against 51.09%
